crm_notes: Summary: Large marketplace with heavy seasonal spikes (Black Friday, Prime-style promos). Goal: reduce avg handle time by 30% and accelerate new-rep ramp via agent assist + one-click tool actions.

Key ask: RAG over hybrid KB (Zendesk articles + Confluence + nightly DB export) with explicit citations and freshness metadata. Customer insists on per-quote provenance and timestamp for legal/regulatory reasons.
POC constraints: must not send PII to hosted vendor; initial ingest will run into Redwood Private (VPC) or on-prem sidecar. Want KMS integration and audit trails for every retrieval/citation event.

Quote from Dir. Support: "We need answers to show where they came from — article id, last-updated, and a link back. If confidence < threshold, show agent a short list of candidate docs, not a hallucinated summary."
Operational: Need tool-calling for ticket workflows (close ticket, add internal note, escalate to ops team). Must integrate with internal ticket API (POST /tickets/{id}/actions).
Reliability: requirement to sustain 3x baseline QPS during promos with <1% error budget on token generation and fast fallback to cached short answers / smaller quantized model during overloads.

Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to buy Dedicated pools for steady baseline and overflow to Dedicated or Private. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization to hit cost targets.
Data sources: Zendesk (primary KB), Confluence (engineering runbooks), internal DB snapshots (customer-facing docs), S3 bucket for attachments.

Success criteria for POC: 1) CITED responses in agent UI for 80% of queries; 2) <300ms median latency for 95th percentile of agent-assist calls under normal load; 3) successful tool-calls for close/escalate in POC sandbox without auth leakage.
Notes: prefer model variants that support function/tool calling + streaming; want a canary rollout and automatic fallback policy configured in Redwood Console.
